derivation: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as G4225 (ποῦ) used with the rising slide of inquiry);
strongs_def: as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what locality
it_def:
1) in qualche luogo
2) quasi
3) con numerali: circa
4) dove? in quale luogo? (quando deriva dal pronome interrogativo pos (che))
